'''Sarinte''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[Mos Ila Spaceport]], he directed fellow Imperials arriving on the planet to the local branch of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]].
